Hepatic changes are generally asymptomatic and self-limiting, 
but rare cases of severe liver damage and liver failure have been 
reported. Abnormalities in liver function tests may occur before 
refeeding and improve during nutritional rehabilitation or arise 
during the course of refeeding. When this occurs during refeed-
ing, it is suggested that increased carbohydrate intake stimulates 
increased insulin secretion causing lipogenesis and fatty changes 
in the liver (Winston, 2012).
